title: Why does my apad output never end?
fullTitle: FFmpeg apad: a 3 s Song Becomes a 12 s File Until You Set a Length

scenes.narration: Add dash a f apad to pad a short song, and the file never finishes. A three second song, a five second picture, f f m peg six point one point one, and a hard dash t on every command. What stops apad?
captions: -af apad, and the file never finishes.

scenes.chapter: The test clip and two readers
scenes.narration: The picture is a flat clip: five seconds, one hundred twenty five frames. The song is a tone: three seconds, one hundred forty four thousand samples. Two readers: ffprobe packets, and decoded frames and samples. Control, no apad: the file is five seconds, the audio ends at three.
captions: Picture: 5 s, 125 frames. Song: 3 s, 144000 samples.
Control, no apad: file 5.000 s, audio ends at 3.000 s.

scenes.narration: Now dash a f apad alone. Nothing stops it. An eight second guard gives eight seconds and three hundred eighty four thousand samples. A twelve second guard gives twelve. The picture stays one hundred twenty five frames. The length is whatever you typed after dash t.

Dash shortest ends the file with the picture: five seconds at any frame rate. But the audio is short: two hundred thirty eight thousand two hundred eight samples, not two hundred forty thousand. Thirty seven milliseconds missing, at every frame rate.

Ask for a length instead. Whole dur five, pad dur two, pad len, whole len: all four stop by themselves, with exactly two hundred forty thousand samples. Whole dur sets the audio, not the file: four gives four seconds of audio. And it never cuts: a seven second song stays seven.

Two catches. A looped still picture is endless, so apad with dash shortest runs to the guard: eight seconds, two hundred frames. Whole dur five fixes it. And a four point three second picture is one hundred eight frames, four point three two seconds: the audio is point zero two short.
captions: 4.3 s: picture 4.32 s (108 frames), audio 4.300 s.

scenes.narration: To stop apad, give it a length, exact to the sample. Dash shortest ends the file but leaves the audio a few milliseconds short. Not tested: other encoders and containers, real music, players, and builds other than six point one point one.
captions: Give apad a length: exact to the sample.
Not tested: other encoders, real music, players.
